categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical device industry with three main business segments: blood purification products, drug delivery devices, and cardiothoracic surgery products. Blood purification is the core business, including a full product chain of hemodialysis equipment and consumables. The company also extends into vascular intervention, diabetes treatment devices, and early to mid-stage kidney disease intervention and treatment devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as hollow fiber hemodialysis membrane dry and wet spinning, precise membrane pore size control, and nanotechnology for dialysis membranes. It has developed automated production lines for hemodialysis devices and membranes, breaking foreign monopolies. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) and product lifecycle management (PLM) methodologies, with strong R&D capabilities supported by multiple national and provincial innovation platforms. Manufacturing includes automated assembly lines and smart manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, dialysis centers, and healthcare institutions both domestically and internationally. The company serves patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD), diabetes, and cardiovascular conditions requiring dialysis, drug delivery, or cardiothoracic surgery devices. Major markets include domestic Chinese hospitals and emerging international markets in Southeast Asia, South America, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Jiangxi, Yunnan, Sichuan, Zhejiang, and Heilongjiang provinces. It has expanded its international footprint with product registrations and sales in over 110 countries and regions, including Indonesia, Peru, Mexico, Russia, and Turkey. The company actively pursues global market expansion aligned with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of medical devices and consumables. It controls the full product chain for blood purification devices, including core components like dialysis membranes, and provides integrated solutions from equipment to consumables.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in blood purification technologies, including the development of new dialysis membranes and equipment, and expanding into continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) and blood dialysis filtration. It invests heavily in R&D (5.14% of revenue in 2024) and pursues product upgrades, domestic substitution of imported products, and expansion into new therapeutic areas such as diabetes and vascular intervention. The company also focuses on digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and global market certification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical devices and consumables, including blood purification equipment, dialysis consumables, drug delivery devices, and cardiothoracic surgery products. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and distributor channels, with a majority through distributors. The company also benefits from government procurement programs and international exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Sanxin Medtec is a leading domestic player in the blood purification medical device sector, holding the largest number of registered products in China for blood purification. It has broken foreign monopolies in key product areas and holds a strong position in domestic alliance procurement. The company is recognized as a top-tier innovator and standard-setter in the industry, competing with both domestic and international medical device manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 15.41% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 227.4 million, up 10.05%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with expanding overseas sales growing nearly 40%. It maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 2.2 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a comprehensive blood purification product portfolio with fully independent R&D and manufacturing capabilities, including proprietary core technologies in dialysis membranes and equipment. It offers integrated solutions covering the entire dialysis process, emphasizing quality, cost-effectiveness, and service. The company’s products have gained multiple international certifications and are recognized for breaking import monopolies, providing reliable, innovative, and domestically produced alternatives to foreign products.
